evidence.supports: Requested design council workspace and initial workflow, not observed user behavior.

unknowns: No real screenshots or visual mockups
No user testing or measured task completion

ux_researcher.position: A single-decision workflow may make the next action clearer than a multi-project overview.
ux_researcher.risk: No evidence that users complete the intended task in three actions.
ux_researcher.proposed_action: Write a three-action task test and inspect empty/error states.

creative_director.position: Prefer typography-led editorial composition that gives the decision and reason primacy.
creative_director.risk: A hero-led design can hide the actionable next step on small screens.
creative_director.proposed_action: Propose an editorial concept and a meaningfully different operational alternative.

design_architect.position: Use adaptable components for decision/status/feedback, not fixed-height hero layouts.
design_architect.risk: The review rail may obscure content at 360px, and component states are unspecified.
design_architect.proposed_action: Define mobile-to-desktop stacking and empty/error/pending states.

critical_reviewer.position: No real UI exists to validate aesthetic, responsive, or usability performance.
critical_reviewer.risk: Declaring S+ now would fabricate design quality.
critical_reviewer.proposed_action: Keep UNSCORED until rendered screenshots and interactions are available.

options.title: Editorial Decision Canvas
options.structural_difference: Primary decision-first editorial page, contextual review rail on desktop, explicit next action on mobile.
options.strength: Strong rationale hierarchy with reduced visual noise.
options.risk: May hide overview when multiple parallel projects grow.
options.estimated_effort: Needs responsive layout proof, not yet estimated.

options.title: Mission Control Workspace
options.structural_difference: Status-first board and filtering, parallel project list, persistent activity queue.
options.risk: High initial cognitive load and generic admin-panel presentation.
options.estimated_effort: More complex status and filter states; not estimated.

objections.issue: Editorial hero could displace the immediate next action on a small screen.
objections.response: Keep next action and current decision in the first viewport and verify on 360px.

objections.issue: Responsive and keyboard claims are hypotheses because no prototype exists.
objections.response: Create a viewport/state matrix and hold all QA claims until real tests.

dissent: UX Researcher: no basis to claim decision-first layout is faster; retains the three-action hypothesis pending observation.

decision.proposal: Recommend Option A as a reversible prototype direction; do not approve release.
decision.rationale: It directly prioritizes decision, justification and next action from the first pilot brief, while B remains a later multi-project candidate.

validation_plan: Render 360px, 390px and 1440px visual targets for Option A with real content.
Verify the active brief and next action can be found in at most three actions.
Test keyboard focus order, error/empty/pending states and meaningful contrast.
Ask Owner to compare real A/B visuals before confirming the aesthetic direction.
